items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens every Tailwind item is styled with (neutral base, light and dark) and their Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` bindings. The CLI adds only the tokens the host does not define yet. The examples compile the same values (examples/studio/tailwind.mjs).

items.name: utils
items.title: Shared helpers
items.description: The class merge helper `cn` and `copyText` (host callback, Clipboard API, then a selection copy that works over plain HTTP) shared by every Tailwind item, installed once in components/utils/.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The one shadcn-style button of the Tailwind items (chat and viewer bar sizes, touch targets of 40-44px), IconButton, and the host actions every block takes (BlockAction, BlockActions, the shared ActionMenu), installed in components/button/ so it never overwrites the host's own button.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: Markdown editor
items.description: A host-owned styled wrapper over the concrete borrowed Markdown controller.
items.docs: Create and own a MarkdownController from @hachej/boring-ui-kit/markdown. Pass it to MarkdownEditor. The wrapper does not acquire resources or dispose the controller. Check the repository release notes for available npm versions; local tarball tests do not establish registry availability.

items.name: html-viewer
items.title: HTML source and passive preview
items.description: Exact HTML source editing with a reconstructed passive preview and borrowed controller. Browser security qualification remains separate.

items.name: pi-chat
items.title: Pi chat
items.description: A complete Tailwind chat over the borrowed native chat controller: composer, messages, one collapsible activity block per turn (tool calls and reasoning), message queue, history, a human-in-the-loop question card, an Approve / Deny card for host tools wrapped with requireApproval optional artifact cards that open generated content in the host's panel, and feedback cards for the opt-in feedback tool (lists, and Show offers that the host page resolves). Chat only: no layout. Owned, editable source; no AI SDK. The optional pi-ambient and pi-workspace blocks build on it.

items.name: pi-ambient
items.title: Pi ambient agent
items.description: AmbientChat, a compact floating agent bar that grows into a chat window over an existing page, and AgentNotifications, toasts for finished, failed and waiting tasks (with the one guarded browser Notification helper). A block over the pi-chat item; its in-window artifact panel uses the pi-workspace layout.

items.name: pi-workspace
items.title: Pi workspace layout
items.description: ArtifactWorkspace: the chat with a right-hand panel that slides in at full height, a resizable divider, full screen, a full-screen sheet on a phone and an opt-in float-when-narrow (the host swaps in AmbientChat from pi-ambient). Layout only; what is open is the host's. Pair it with the viewers item for the panel contents. Also dock.tsx: composable docks (DockLayout, Dock, DockMain, useDock) for any host content on the left or right of the main area, each resizable, floatable, closable and a full-screen sheet on a phone.

items.name: pi-app
items.title: Pi agent app
items.description: AgentWorkspace: a whole agent page in one component. Left: the sessions pane (search, New, rename, archive, delete; collapsible, a drawer on a narrow screen). Center: PiChat. Right: the artifact viewers (artifact panel with versions, file viewer, auto-open of new artifacts) in the ArtifactWorkspace panel, a full-screen sheet on a phone. Props are data and callbacks; hooks for the conversations handler (useConversations), the chat transport (useRemoteChat) and saved resources (useSaved).

items.name: viewers
items.title: Viewers
items.description: The standard viewer top bar (title, status, viewer controls, Refresh, Share, Copy, Download, Open in new tab, Close, overflow menu) with Tailwind panes over it: the Markdown editor with a formatting toolbar and prose styling, the passive HTML preview and source editor, an image viewer with zoom and pan, and a PDF viewer. Owned, editable source over the borrowed controllers; no AI SDK.

.boring-viewer .boring-markdown-source,.font: 0.8125rem/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

.boring-viewer .boring-viewer-checker.background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, #d4d4d8 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, #d4d4d8 75%), linear-gradient(45deg, #d4d4d8 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, #d4d4d8 75%)

items.name: provider-setup
items.title: Provider setup
items.description: A Tailwind popover for configuring model access: pick any registered Pi provider and model, save an API key (masked, shows "saved"), run a device-code subscription sign-in (code, link and status), set an optional gateway and see when a provider needs one. Transport-agnostic: props in, callbacks out, no fetch. Owned, editable source; fits the pi-chat controls slot.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: Feedback from the chat composer: one Feedback button starts feedback mode on the application page (hover, click to pin a numbered note, hold ⌥ to use the app, optional voice), and one chip carries the notes to the next message. FeedbackBar, NoteBubble, FeedbackChip with its review, useComposerFeedback for the pi-chat composer, and PickerOverlay styles. Optional, not mounted by default: PointButton, AnnotateSheet, FeedbackList and FeedbackReport. Picking, masking, anchoring and placement stay in @hachej/boring-feedback/page and /ui, so restyling cannot weaken them.

items.name: feedback-preview
items.title: Feedback preview
items.description: PreviewBanner: a live, reversible preview of a change in the page (Approve / Discard) over `@hachej/boring-feedback/preview`, whose subagent calls models through a host gateway. Separate from `feedback` so annotation-only apps do not install the model SDK; install `feedback` first (its styles cover the banner).

items.name: task-list-viewer
items.title: Consumer task-list viewer
items.description: A consumer-defined task-list schema and controller over the shared text buffer, with a restylable borrowed React renderer.
items.docs: The installed task-list schema/controller are trusted consumer code; publication and draft recovery come from @hachej/boring-ui-kit/text-buffer. Construct a feature with a host-authenticated ResourceClient and exact source, then pass its concrete controller to TaskListViewer. Install native tools separately on the server. No host credentials or native kernel are copied into this item. Local tarball qualification only; no hosted release endpoint is advertised.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File tree
items.description: Browse, search, upload and inspect retained versions through one revisionProvider binding.
